messages:
maya: Anyone else seeing a weird p99-only spike for /service/api/ingress on the rollout canary? p50/p95 look normal, p99 jumps ~3x for some caller tags.

arun: Yeah noticed that on the chart this morning. looks localized to caller_tag=mobile_iOS and caller_tag=internal-test.

telemetry-bot: New rollout: canary v2.3.1 deployed to 10% traffic at 08:12 UTC. Telemetry window open.

linh: quick suspicion: retries might be getting double-counted for some ingress paths due to the new routing header rewrite. checking samples now.

arun: can you paste the query you're using to inspect samples? want to see raw latencies by sample_origin.

maya: sure — ran a short ad-hoc: ```sql
SELECT sample_origin, caller_tag, percentile(latency_ms, 50) AS p50, percentile(latency_ms, 95) AS p95, percentile(latency_ms, 99) AS p99, count(*)
FROM telemetry_latency
WHERE route = '/service/api/ingress' AND time >= now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY sample_origin, caller_tag
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

linh: results: for sample_origin = ingress-proxy, caller_tag=mobile_iOS -> p99 ~ 1.2s, p95 120ms. sample_origin = retry-path shows p99s similar magnitude but only for a subset of request_ids. I think the new header rewrite makes some retries lose the "is_retry" tag so they get aggregated under original path.

arun: ah that would inflate tail. Is the telemetry ingest deduping by request_id?

paul: dug in — ingest deduping runs on request_id when present, but header rewrite changed name from `x-rw-request-id` to `x-rw-req` for canary routes. we didn't map the alias in the routing middleware. fix: mapping + backfill. pushing patch to canary now.

maya: awesome. timeline? can we rollback mapping quickly if backfill looks noisy?

paul: patch in CI, will roll to canary in ~5m. backfill job scheduled, will backfill last 2h. will post job link when running.

maya: thanks — once patch is in canary we'll recheck p99. adding follow-up ticket RT-4321 to track backfill and dashboard annotation so this doesn't confuse folks next time. :thumbsup:
